facts.fact: Côte d'Ivoire signed a non-binding memorandum with G42 Presight and the Ministry of Digital Transition and Digitalization on developing a national digital strategy, as the National Digital Development Strategy (SNDN), launched five years earlier, was due to expire in 2025 (We Are Tech Africa, 15 July 2025; MoU signed 10 July 2025).
facts.system: national digital strategy (successor to the National Digital Development Strategy, SNDN)

facts.fact: The article credits the SNDN with over 5,207 km of fibre-optic cable deployed, several online public service portals and an operational National Cybersecurity Agency, without measuring them against stated targets; date given is the article's 15 July 2025.
